title: TFC More Cans and Jars
description: Add more cans and jars for TFC.
body:
Add more cans and jars for TFC.

Salted vegetable jar, salted meat jar, candied fruit jar: similar to vanilla jam jar, crafted by jar+salt/sugar+food ingredient, long expiration date, can be used in workbench to open the jar to get salted vegetable, salted meat, candied fruit.

Iron can: need a kinfe to open after sealing. Any vanilla foods that can be used in soup can be used in cans.

All jars and cans can be boiled in tfc pot / firmalife vat. Boiled jars and cans have infinite expiration date.

Salted vegetable, salted meat, candied fruit, canned food can used to make sandwich / salad / soup / jam sandwich.

If tfc+ie crossover mod is installed, this mod will add aluminum can, which is similar to iron cans. IE metal press can make cans.

给群峦传说加入了更多罐头

咸菜/咸肉/蜜饯罐头：类似于原版果酱罐头，用玻璃罐+盐/糖+食材合成，保质期长。可以工作台合成打开罐头取出咸菜/咸肉/蜜饯。

铁皮罐头：封装后需要用小刀打开，任何可以用作煮汤原料的食物都可以装罐。

所有罐头都可以在陶锅/firmalife不锈钢锅中水煮灭菌，灭菌罐头保质期无限。

咸菜/咸肉/蜜饯/罐头菜可以用于制作三明治/沙拉/汤/果酱三明治。

如果装了群峦沉浸联动模组，模组会新增铝皮罐头，用法同铁皮罐头。金属冲压机可以制作罐头。
